crossRefs.note: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting…
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering.They washed their…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…
Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new…
Therefore tell them: Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says…
Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from…
Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

translations.web: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
translations.bsb: Wash and cleanse yourselves. Remove your evil deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil!
translations.kjv: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
